title: The Preaching of the Word
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The preaching of the Word is the faithful proclamation of Scripture so that God’s people are taught, corrected, warned, comforted, and called to Christ. Preaching is not entertainment, self-expression, or motivational speech, but ministry under God’s Word.
summary: The preaching of the Word is the faithful proclamation of Scripture so that God’s people are taught, corrected, warned, comforted, and called to Christ. Preaching is not entertainment, self-expression, or motivational speech, but ministry under God’s Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the center of faithful preaching. The preached Word must lead hearers to His person, Gospel, commands, mercy, judgment, and hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God builds His church through His Word. Preaching is one appointed means by which Scripture is proclaimed, explained, applied, and pressed upon the hearts of hearers.

Faithful preaching must be governed by Scripture. The preacher is not called to display personality, entertain crowds, or promote personal opinions, but to preach the Word in season and out of season.

Preaching includes teaching, reproof, rebuke, exhortation, patience, and doctrine. It must not avoid hard truths or neglect Gospel comfort. It should call people to Christ and faithful obedience.

The power of preaching is not in human cleverness. Faith comes through hearing the Word of Christ, and God is pleased to use the proclaimed Gospel to save, strengthen, and sanctify.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Churches can be tempted to replace preaching with entertainment, personality, politics, or shallow encouragement. This leaves people spiritually underfed.

This doctrine reminds the church that people need God’s Word more than performance. The weary need truth, the lost need the Gospel, the tempted need warning, and the saints need Christ proclaimed faithfully.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Value faithful preaching and pray for those who proclaim the Word. Listen with humility, test what you hear by Scripture, and respond in faith and obedience. If you teach or preach, tremble before the Word and aim to make Christ known, not yourself impressive.
